articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window available at launch. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science QA and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap with specialized domain models. The model is available through the API with a new tiered pricing structure based on reasoning depth.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on SWE-Bench, WebArena, and other agentic evaluation suites, demonstrating the ability to autonomously complete multi-step software engineering and web navigation tasks with minimal human oversight. The model introduces a novel self-verification loop that reduces hallucination rates by over 40% compared to its predecessor. Google is integrating the model across Workspace and Cloud Platform offerings.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots have moved beyond pilot testing and are now operating in regular production shifts at BMW's Spartanburg facility, performing parts inspection, bin picking, and material transport tasks. The deployment marks one of the first scaled commercial uses of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing. Figure reports the units are achieving 94% task completion rates with a mean time between failures exceeding 18 hours.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Chaining
articles.summary: Tesla showed a live demonstration of its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot performing chained household tasks including laundry folding, dish loading, and floor cleanup without per-task human prompting. The robot uses an on-device vision-language-action model fine-tuned on teleoperation data, representing a shift toward generalist home robotics. Tesla indicated plans for a limited external beta program starting Q4 2026 priced under $25,000.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Computer Use 2.0 with Persistent Memory and Tool Orchestration
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major upgrade to Claude's computer use capabilities, adding persistent cross-session memory, parallel tool orchestration, and a secure sandbox environment for autonomous desktop workflows. The system can now maintain context across multi-day tasks such as research projects and code refactoring efforts. Enterprise customers report up to 5x productivity gains for repetitive back-office operations in early access testing.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node using next-generation gate-all-around transistor architecture, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over N2, with Apple and NVIDIA confirmed as lead customers. This development intensifies competition with Samsung Foundry and Intel, both of which have faced delays on comparable nodes.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to begin clinical trials with its N2 implant, which features 4x the electrode density of the original device and bidirectional stimulation capabilities enabling both neural reading and writing. The first cohort will focus on patients with spinal cord injuries, with the goal of restoring not just cursor control but also tactile feedback. The approval follows positive 18-month safety data from the first-generation implant trials.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters and MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest open-source model to date, using a mixture-of-experts architecture with 2 trillion total parameters and 400 billion active per forward pass. The model matches or exceeds several proprietary frontier models on standard benchmarks while running efficiently on 8-GPU clusters through aggressive expert parallelism. The release has sparked rapid community fine-tuning efforts and renewed debate about the safety implications of open-weight frontier models.
